meta.name: PiHub Investor V3
meta.description: Institutional financial operating interface for opportunity, credit-request and investment workflows.
source_references: UI/UX Pro Max financial dashboard guidance

secondary.role: navigation shell and high-emphasis structural surfaces

accent.role: rare visual accent in authentication WebGL and focus details

neutral.usage: cool neutral hierarchy for canvas, surfaces, borders and text

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light workspace with high-contrast midnight navigation; body text AA or better

typography.font_style_notes: serious humanist-grotesk sans with mono numerals for amounts, dates and IDs

spacing.section_rhythm: 24-32px between related workspace sections; 40-48px only for top-level page separation

layout.grid_system: 12-column responsive grid with fixed desktop rail

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px borders on product surfaces and controls

elevation.depth_cues: borders and surface tone first, shadow second

iconography.preferred_set: existing Boxicons until a controlled Lucide migration

motion.entrance_pattern: 10-18px translate plus opacity, hero first, supporting content staggered 35-45ms
motion.philosophy: minimal functional corporate-premium motion with no bounce

components.button_style: 10px radius, cobalt primary, neutral secondary, explicit hover/focus/active/disabled states
components.input_style: 44-48px, visible label, white surface, neutral border and cobalt focus ring
components.card_style: border-first white surfaces with low shadow and compact headers
components.navigation_pattern: 232px persistent desktop rail; compact horizontal navigation on small screens
components.modal_style: centered elevated white sheet with 50% black scrim and clear close action
components.list_style: dense table/list with subtle row hover, sticky header when possible, mono numeric columns
components.component_notes: pills only for status and segmented controls; no ornamental cards

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: navigation and page heading establish structure, tables and metrics carry most visual weight
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal with one primary action per view

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy, spacing and surface grouping
composition.flow_direction: top-left to right then down through data
composition.negative_space_role: separates decision areas and keeps dense data readable

imagery.illustration_style: abstract data topology only on authentication
imagery.graphic_elements: subtle grid, hairline dividers and restrained status marks
imagery.pattern_usage: very subtle technical grid on auth visual only
imagery.image_shape: functional rectangular assets, 10-12px radius where used

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: background/border shift with maximum 1-2px transform on focal controls

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain why it is empty and provide the next useful action

overview.performance_tier: medium with optional WebGL auth scene
overview.fallback_strategy: disable WebGL and spatial motion for reduced-motion or low-power devices; keep static gradient/grid
overview.primary_technology: GSAP for UI motion and Three.js for authentication-only brand scene

background_effects.description: static cool grid and soft radial gradient on authentication visual

particle_systems.description: low-count capital-topology points on auth only

3d_elements.description: abstract risk/capital topology with one shader-displaced surface and connected point field

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer alpha=true, antialias=true, DPR capped at 1.5
params.lighting: not required for shader/points; optional soft ambient for basic meshes
params.materials: ShaderMaterial for surface, PointsMaterial/LineBasicMaterial for topology
params.interaction_model: subtle pointer-derived rotation, no direct manipulation

shader_effects.description: very low amplitude vertex displacement on authentication topology surface

scroll_morphing.description: not appropriate for dense financial workflow

cursor_effects.description: standard cursor for predictable enterprise interaction

image_effects.description: no decorative image effects in app

canvas_drawings.description: Three.js covers the only advanced visual scene

visual_effects.composite_notes: Core workflow remains CSS/React-first. GSAP animates only hierarchy and state. Three.js is isolated to the unauthenticated visual panel, disposed on page hide, and disabled under reduced-motion or low-power conditions.
